title: NET Toolkit
summary: NET Toolkit是给CardputerZero用的随身网络工具箱，把现场排障常用的命令做成一块小屏就能操作的界面。
description:
主要功能：
• 接口配置：查看链路/IP/MAC/网关/DNS，支持 DHCP 或静态地址
• Ping：逐包延迟、丢包率、min/avg/max/mdev 与抖动统计
• 端口扫描：TCP 端口列表扫描，开放端口绿色高亮
• 路由追踪：逐跳路径与每跳延迟，可设置最大跳数
• 局域网扫描：发现同网段设备的 IP/MAC/厂家，并识别 Web 管理页
• DNS / ARP：A/AAAA 与反向解析、IP→MAC 与厂家识别
• SSH / Telnet / 串口：交互式终端，共享 39×10 字符屏幕
• 子网计算器：IP 与掩码分开输入，输出网络/掩码/通配符/广播/可用范围/主机数
• Wi-Fi 信号：实时信号强度与曲线、周边 AP 表格（信道/信号/dBm/加密）、信道占用图，选中项可上下翻页
• Wi-Fi 连接：选中 AP 输入密码即可连接；系统里保存过的网络只需设备密码，并可按 P 查看已保存密码
• 热点：开启 WPA2 热点；接有线回程时可共享上网，面板会显示上行状态
• 网速测试：10 秒 HTTP 下载测速，显示平均 Mbps、耗时与 TTFB
• 文件投送：局域网 HTTP 投递，一次性 PIN
• 历史与设置：结果可保存、逐条删除；中英文、主题、Ping 次数、追踪跳数均可调整
快捷键：
• 全局：Ctrl+S 保存结果，Ctrl+L 中英文，Ctrl+T 主题，Ctrl+I 设置，Ctrl+C 停止任务
• 菜单：F 上移，X 下移，Z 向左翻页，C 向右翻页，Enter 打开，Esc 退出
• Wi-Fi：Enter 连接选中 AP，C 切换信道图，R 重新扫描，P 查看已保存密码
• 历史：Enter 查看记录，DEL 删除；记录详情页按 Esc 返回历史列表
• SSH 表单：Ctrl+S 保存书签，Ctrl+B 读取书签，Ctrl+K 清除 SSH 指纹
说明：修改网络设置、连接 Wi-Fi 和开关热点需要输入设备密码，仅在用户主动操作时提权执行；应用不安装 sudoers 文件，也不包含常驻后台服务。
Features:
- Interfaces: link, IPv4, MAC, gateway, DNS; DHCP or static addressing
- Ping: per-reply latency, loss, min/avg/max/mdev and jitter
- Port scan: TCP port lists with open ports highlighted
- Traceroute: hop-by-hop path and latency, configurable max hops
- LAN scan: discover neighbours with IP/MAC/vendor and spot web admin pages
- DNS / ARP: A/AAAA and reverse lookups, IP to MAC with OUI vendor
- SSH / Telnet / Serial: interactive consoles on a shared 39x10 terminal
- Subnet calculator: separate IP and mask fields; network, wildcard,
  broadcast, usable range and host count
- Wi-Fi: live RSSI and sparkline, nearby AP table (channel, signal, dBm,
  encryption), channel-load chart, paged selection
- Wi-Fi connect: tap an AP and enter its password; saved networks only ask
  for the device password, and P reveals the saved password
- Hotspot: WPA2 access point; shares a wired uplink and shows its state
- Speed test: 10 second HTTP download with average Mbps, elapsed and TTFB
- File drop: local HTTP upload page with a one-time PIN
- History and settings: save results, delete entries, language, theme,
  ping count and traceroute hops
Shortcuts:
- Global: Ctrl+S save, Ctrl+L language, Ctrl+T theme, Ctrl+I settings,
  Ctrl+C stop a running task
- Menu: F up, X down, Z page left, C page right, Enter open, Esc exit
- Wi-Fi: Enter connect the selected AP, C toggle channel chart, R rescan,
  P reveal the saved password
- History: Enter open a record, DEL delete, Esc returns to the list
- SSH form: Ctrl+S save bookmark, Ctrl+B load bookmark, Ctrl+K clear host keys
Network changes, Wi-Fi joins and hotspot switching ask for the device
password and run only on user action; the package installs no sudoers file
and no background service.
